newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK INSTITUTIONS WORRIED BY BOURSE CUL-DE-SAC.
newsitem.headline: GREEK INSTITUTIONS WORRIED BY BOURSE CUL-DE-SAC.

text.p: Greece's institutional investors said on Monday they were deeply concerned by a settlement crisis afflicting the Athens bourse which risked damaging credibility with the investment public.

Drastic state intervention was required to see that a full investigation exposed the parties responsible for the settlement problem, the union of mutual fund management companies and closed-end investment funds said in a statement.
The capital markets commission had to move fast and recruit the necessary staff to be able to execute its supervisory role, it said. Regulatory measures were needed to return the market to normalcy.

"At this juncture, the union wishes to underline that institutional investors play a stabilising role in the capital market and protect investors interests," their union said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
